cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance whose meta‑schema is the default (Draft‑07). The schema should validate a JSON string successfully.
cases.description: Pass a minimal valid JSON Schema (type string) without an explicit $schema. The factory should create a JsonSchema using the default meta‑schema (Draft‑07) and return a usable JsonSchema object.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance whose meta‑schema URI is "http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#" (Draft‑04). The schema should accept integer values and reject non‑integers.
cases.description: Provide a schema that explicitly declares Draft‑04 via $schema. The factory must recognise the $schema keyword, load the corresponding meta‑schema and return a JsonSchema bound to Draft‑04.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance whose meta‑schema is the default (Draft‑07) and whose schema location is set to the provided $id URI.
cases.description: Supply a schema that contains an $id field. The factory should keep the $id as the schema location while still using the default meta‑schema because no $schema keyword is present.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance representing an empty schema (always valid). The meta‑schema should be the default (Draft‑07).
cases.description: Pass an empty JSON object. The factory must still return a valid JsonSchema object that imposes no constraints.

cases.expected: NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) thrown because the jsonNode argument is null.
cases.description: Calling getSchema(null) should fail fast, as the method expects a non‑null JsonNode to build a schema.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or similar) indicating that the root node must be an object, not an array.
cases.description: Supply a JSON array as the schema root. The factory should detect the invalid root type and raise an appropriate exception.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or fallback to default) because the $schema URI cannot be resolved to a known meta‑schema.
cases.description: Provide a $schema value that does not correspond to any built‑in meta‑schema. The factory should either throw an exception or fall back to the default meta‑schema; the test asserts the expected failure mode.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance that always validates any JSON instance successfully (boolean schema true).
cases.description: Pass a boolean true as the schema root. According to the JSON‑Schema specification a boolean true represents a schema that matches everything. The factory should return a JsonSchema that never produces validation errors.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance that always fails validation (boolean schema false).
cases.description: Pass a boolean false as the schema root. This represents a schema that matches no instance. The factory should create a JsonSchema that reports a validation error for any input.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance whose meta‑schema URI is "http://json-schema.org/draft-06/schema#" (Draft‑06). The schema validates boolean values.
cases.description: Supply a schema that explicitly requests Draft‑06 via $schema. The factory must recognise the URI, load the Draft‑06 meta‑schema and bind the resulting JsonSchema to it.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance whose meta‑schema URI is "https://json-schema.org/draft/2019-09/schema" (Draft‑2019‑09). The schema validates null values.
cases.description: Provide a schema that targets the newer Draft‑2019‑09 meta‑schema. The factory should correctly resolve this URI and create a JsonSchema using that meta‑schema.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance whose meta‑schema URI is "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema" (Draft‑2020‑12). The schema validates arrays of integers.
cases.description: Test the factory with the most recent Draft‑2020‑12 meta‑schema. The expected behavior is that the factory loads this meta‑schema and returns a JsonSchema bound to it.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance whose meta‑schema is the default (Draft‑07) and that resolves the internal $ref successfully; validation of the integer 5 succeeds, validation of 0 fails.
cases.description: Create a schema that defines an internal definition via $defs and references it with $ref. The factory must build a JsonSchema capable of resolving the reference. The test asserts that the resulting schema behaves as expected for valid and invalid instances.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IllegalArgumentException) indicating that the root node must be an object, array, or boolean schema, not a JSON string.
cases.description: Pass a JSON string as the schema root. The factory should reject this as an invalid schema representation.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IllegalArgumentException) indicating that the root node must be an object, array, or boolean schema, not a numeric literal.
cases.description: Pass a JSON number as the schema root. The method must fail with an appropriate exception.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance that falls back to the default meta‑schema (Draft‑07) because the $schema value is empty.
cases.description: Provide an empty string for $schema. The factory should treat it as unspecified and use the default meta‑schema.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance that falls back to the default meta‑schema (Draft‑07) because the $schema value is null.
cases.description: Supply a null $schema value. The factory must ignore the null and default to Draft‑07.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance that successfully parses the schema, ignoring the unknownKeyword, and validates objects with a string "id" property.
cases.description: Include a custom, unknown keyword in the schema. The factory should not fail; it must ignore unknown keywords per the specification and still produce a usable JsonSchema.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException (or JsonSchemaException) indicating that the $id value is not a valid URI and cannot be parsed.
cases.description: Pass a schema with a malformed $id URI. The factory should detect the invalid URI during schema location creation and throw an appropriate exception.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or SchemaNotFoundException) because the external schema referenced by $ref cannot be loaded.
cases.description: Supply a $ref that points to an external URI that is not available in the classpath or reachable. Schema loading should fail and raise an exception.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IllegalStateException) indicating a circular reference was detected while resolving $ref.
cases.description: Create a schema where definitions reference each other in a loop. The factory must detect the circular reference during schema construction and throw an exception.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException (or JsonSchemaException) because the $schema value is not a syntactically valid URI.
cases.description: Provide a $schema keyword with a string that is not a URI. The factory should reject the value and fail fast.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IllegalArgumentException) indicating that the $ref target is not a schema node.
cases.description: Reference a JSON pointer that resolves to a primitive value (the title string) rather than a schema object. The factory should raise an exception because $ref must point to a schema.
